entities.name: ChatGPT

entities.name: Claude
entities.note: Anthropic's assistant and model family.

entities.name: Gemini
entities.note: Google's assistant and model family.

entities.name: Grok
entities.note: xAI's assistant, distributed through X.

entities.name: Copilot
entities.note: Microsoft's assistant family: Microsoft 365 Copilot, GitHub Copilot, Copilot Studio.

entities.name: TPU
entities.note: Google's in-house AI accelerator, sold through Google Cloud and, as racks, through Broadcom.

entities.name: Trainium
entities.note: Amazon's in-house AI accelerator, used through AWS.

entities.name: SoftBank
entities.note: Investor. Funds OpenAI through SoftBank Vision Fund 2.

entities.name: Hyperion bonds
entities.note: A financial instrument, not a company: $27.3B of notes issued by Beignet Investor LLC (Blue Owl funds) to finance the Meta–Blue Owl Hyperion data-center venture in Louisiana.

entities.name: SpaceX
entities.note: Public since June 2026 (Nasdaq: SPCX). Owns xAI, renamed SpaceXAI and then SpaceXSI, since February 2026, and Cursor since August 2026. Rents GPU compute to Anthropic.

entities.name: Meta AI
entities.note: Meta's assistant in its own app and across WhatsApp, Instagram, Facebook and Messenger. Runs on Muse models from Meta Superintelligence Labs since April 2026, replacing Llama.

entities.name: Cursor
entities.note: AI coding app made by Anysphere. Acquired by SpaceX in an all-stock deal that closed on 14 August 2026.

entities.name: Perplexity
entities.note: Answer engine. Private and publishes no revenue figures, so its rows are press-graded.

entities.name: Mistral
entities.note: French lab. Ships open-weight models and the Le Chat assistant.

entities.name: DeepSeek
entities.note: Chinese lab. Open-weight models and a low-price API.

entities.name: Alibaba Qwen
entities.note: Alibaba's Qwen model family: open-weight releases plus hosted Plus and Max models.

entities.name: Nebius
entities.note: AI cloud company listed on Nasdaq (NBIS). Rents dedicated GPU capacity to Microsoft and Meta under five-year contracts; Nvidia is a shareholder.

entities.name: Nscale
entities.note: UK-based AI cloud company; filed for a US listing in September 2026. Microsoft and Anthropic are its largest contracted customers.

entities.name: IREN
entities.note: AI cloud company listed on Nasdaq, formerly a bitcoin miner. Rents GB300 capacity to Microsoft from its Childress, Texas campus.

entities.name: G42
entities.note: Abu Dhabi AI company. Its Khazna unit is building the 1 GW Stargate UAE cluster with OpenAI, Oracle, Nvidia, Cisco and SoftBank.

entities.name: Samsung
entities.note: Memory maker. Joined OpenAI's Stargate initiative in October 2025 to scale DRAM supply.

entities.name: SK hynix
entities.note: Memory maker. Joined OpenAI's Stargate initiative in October 2025 to scale DRAM supply.

entities.name: SB Energy
entities.note: SoftBank Group company that develops data-center campuses and power. OpenAI and SoftBank invested $1B in January 2026.

entities.name: Vistra
entities.note: Power generator. Sells Meta 2,609 MW of nuclear energy and uprates from three PJM plants under 20-year agreements.

entities.name: TerraPower
entities.note: Advanced-nuclear developer. Meta funds up to eight Natrium units.

entities.name: Oklo
entities.note: Advanced-nuclear developer. Meta prepays for power from a planned 1.2 GW campus in Ohio.

entities.name: MGX
entities.note: Abu Dhabi technology investor. An initial equity funder of Stargate and a co-lead of Anthropic's Series G.

entities.name: Apollo
entities.note: Asset manager. An Apollo-managed entity committed to finance-lease about $40B of GPU equipment to SpaceX.

entities.name: Blue Owl
entities.note: Private-credit and real-asset manager. Led IREN's $2.4B GPU financing with PIMCO; partner in Meta's Hyperion joint venture.

entities.name: Micron
entities.note: Memory maker. One of seven tech companies buying Anthropic shares at its IPO price in a $26B concurrent private placement.

entities.name: NextEra Energy
entities.note: Utility and power developer. Restarting the Duane Arnold nuclear plant for Google; about 2.5 GW of new contracts with Meta.

entities.name: Brookfield
entities.note: Asset manager and, through Brookfield Renewable, power generator. Sells Google hydropower; funds Bloom fuel cells for AI factories.

entities.name: Intersect
entities.note: Data center and power developer that co-locates generation with data centers. Alphabet agreed to buy it for $4.75B in December 2025.

entities.name: Entergy
entities.note: Utility. Building ten gas plants in Louisiana for Meta's Hyperion data center, paid for by Meta.

entities.name: VoltaGrid
entities.note: Modular natural-gas power company. Deploying 2.3 GW for Oracle's Texas AI data centers, fueled by Energy Transfer pipelines.

entities.name: Bloom Energy
entities.note: Fuel-cell maker. Powers Oracle data centers, supplies AEP's 702 MW plant for Google, and has a $5B deployment deal with Brookfield.

entities.name: Kairos Power
entities.note: Advanced-nuclear developer. Its Hermes 2 reactor is the first deployment under a 500 MW agreement with Google.

entities.name: Commonwealth Fusion
entities.note: Fusion developer. Google and Nvidia invested in its $863M Series B2; Google has agreed to buy 200 MW from its first plant.

entities.name: DTE Energy
entities.note: Michigan utility. Powers the 1.4 GW Stargate campus that Oracle, OpenAI and Related Digital are building in Saline Township.

entities.name: AEP
entities.note: Utility. Building a 702 MW Bloom fuel-cell plant for Google and studying a 960 MW X-energy nuclear plant funded by Amazon.

entities.name: Constellation
entities.note: Largest US nuclear operator. Sells Amazon 690 MW from Calvert Cliffs under a 20-year agreement.

entities.name: X-energy
entities.note: Advanced-nuclear developer. Amazon funds development of a 960 MW Xe-100 plant with AEP in Indiana.

entities.name: ASML
entities.note: Maker of the lithography machines every leading-edge chip needs. Led Mistral's Series C with €1.3B for about 11%.

entities.name: Intel
entities.note: Chipmaker. Nvidia bought $5B of its stock and is co-developing custom data-center CPUs with it.

entities.name: Groq
entities.note: Inference-chip maker (LPU). Licensed its technology to Nvidia, non-exclusively, as its founder and president joined Nvidia.

entities.name: Cerebras
entities.note: Wafer-scale chip maker. Selling OpenAI 750 MW of inference compute through 2028.

entities.name: Marvell
entities.note: Custom AI chips and optical interconnect. Nvidia invested $2B and brought it into NVLink Fusion.

entities.name: Lambda
entities.note: AI cloud company. Multibillion-dollar, multi-year contract to deploy Nvidia GPUs for Microsoft.

entities.name: Fluidstack
entities.note: AI cloud company that builds and runs clusters for labs; builds Anthropic's US data centers. Leases from TeraWulf and Cipher, backstopped by Google.

entities.name: TeraWulf
entities.note: Former bitcoin miner turned AI data-center landlord. Leases about 360 MW to Fluidstack; Google backstops the leases for warrants worth about 14%.

entities.name: Cipher Mining
entities.note: Former bitcoin miner turned AI data-center landlord. 15-year, $5.5B lease with AWS; Fluidstack lease backstopped by Google.

entities.name: Aligned Data Centers
entities.note: Data-center developer with 51 campuses and over 6.4 GW operational and planned. Bought for about $40B by AIP, MGX and BlackRock's GIP.

entities.name: Humain
entities.note: Saudi PIF-owned AI company. Plans up to 600,000 Nvidia GPUs, a 500 MW+ flagship data center with xAI, and a joint venture with AMD and Cisco for up to 1 GW.

entities.name: Lancium
entities.note: Blackstone-backed power and land developer behind the Stargate campus in Abilene, Texas. Nvidia reportedly agreed to buy about 20%.

entities.name: Thinking Machines
entities.note: AI lab founded by former OpenAI CTO Mira Murati. Nvidia invested twice and Thinking Machines will deploy at least 1 GW of Vera Rubin systems.

entities.name: AI Infrastructure Partnership
entities.note: Investment vehicle founded by BlackRock, GIP, MGX, Microsoft and Nvidia, later joined by xAI, KIA and Temasek. First deal: Aligned Data Centers.

entities.name: BlackRock
entities.note: Asset manager; owns Global Infrastructure Partners. Chairs the AI Infrastructure Partnership; one of Nvidia's six compute-financing partners.

entities.name: Blackstone
entities.note: Largest alternative asset manager; backs Lancium and owns QTS data centers. One of Nvidia's six compute-financing partners.

entities.name: Hugging Face
entities.note: The open-model hub: more than 18 million developers sharing over 3 million models, 500,000 datasets and 1 million applications. Nvidia agreed to buy it for $12.93B on 2 Sep 2026; the deal has not closed (expected first half of 2027, pending regulatory approval). Nvidia was already an investor through Hugging Face's 2023 round.

entities.name: Nemotron
entities.note: Nvidia's family of open-weight models for AI agents: weights, training data and recipes published. Nemotron 3 shipped from December 2025 to June 2026; Nemotron 3.5 followed.

entities.name: Funding rounds
entities.note: All investors in an application company's funding round, as one total. Where an investor already on the map took part, it also gets its own line, with no amount unless its share was disclosed, so nothing is counted twice.

entities.name: U.S. Army
entities.note: Buys AI software and systems through ten-year enterprise agreements with ceilings, not commitments.

entities.name: Tesla
entities.note: Full Self-Driving, its Robotaxi service and Optimus robots. Buys AI chips from Samsung and TSMC; co-develops the Terafab chip plant with SpaceX.

entities.name: Tesla FSD
entities.note: Tesla's Full Self-Driving software and Robotaxi service.

entities.name: Optimus
entities.note: Tesla's humanoid robot.

entities.name: Waymo
entities.note: Robotaxi service, majority-owned by Alphabet.

entities.name: Wayve
entities.note: End-to-end AI driving software licensed to carmakers and robotaxi fleets, including Uber.

entities.name: Figure
entities.note: Humanoid robots running its own Helix AI.

entities.name: Skild AI
entities.note: A general-purpose AI "brain" for many kinds of robots.

entities.name: Palantir
entities.note: AI Platform (AIP) and Ontology software for governments and companies.

entities.name: Anduril
entities.note: Autonomous defense systems run by its Lattice software.

entities.name: Terafab
entities.note: SpaceX and Tesla chip plant planned in Grimes County, Texas, making logic, memory and packaging under one roof.
